_comment: V2 Phase 1B (BL-019, docs/v2/10-BACKLOG.md). Every id below was verified directly against live data/entities/ (2026-08-14), not copied from docs/v2/04-DOMAIN-PACK-SPEC.md's own illustrative 'Berries example', which listed traits (ownership, headquarters_country, region, filing_date, expiry_date) that do not exist as real trait entities in data/entities/traits/ -- corrected here to match verified data instead of that earlier, unverified example.

entity_types.label: Company
entity_types._comment: No trait entities are currently linked to company-type entities in live data; company characteristics are recorded as free-form entity.attributes, not the controlled trait vocabulary.

entity_types.label: Variety
entity_types._comment: All 10 trait entities in data/entities/traits/ describe variety-level measurable characteristics -- verified directly, not assumed. Ids match data/entities/traits/*.json exactly (also taxonomies/trait-vocabulary.json's ids), for direct traceability rather than a parallel vocabulary-id namespace.

entity_types.label: Geography
entity_types._comment: No 'region' trait entity exists in live data (unlike docs/v2/04-DOMAIN-PACK-SPEC.md's illustrative example) -- geography's region grouping is handled by app/main.py's REGION_LOOKUP constant today, not a trait.

entity_types.label: Patent
entity_types._comment: No 'filing_date'/'expiry_date' trait entities exist in live data -- these are plain entity.attributes fields today, not the controlled trait vocabulary.

entity_types.label: Trait
entity_types._comment: The trait vocabulary's own container entity type -- a trait entity does not itself have traits.
